name: Henjin Bakari no Kono Class de Heiwa na Seishun wa Okuremasu ka?
original_name: 変人ばかりのこのクラスで平和な青春は送れますか？
source:
The main character, in their second year of high school, wants to be a representative for the school festival! In order to fully enjoy their youth and to find love, they will aim to win first place in the class performance on the day of the festival!

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220517201157/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.henjin]Google Play[/url]]
